definitions.explanation: A thin, flat television using LCD, LED, or similar panel technology, as opposed to the bulky cathode-ray-tube sets that came before.

examples.japanese: {薄型|うすがた}テレビ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{替|か}えた→買い替える：19456_kaikaeru⟧。
examples.english: I replaced it with a flat-screen TV.

examples.japanese: {薄型|うすがた}テレビ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かけられる→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: A flat-screen TV can be mounted on the wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{薄型|うすがた}テレビ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{画質|がしつ}→画質：16156_gashitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧、⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{下|さ}がって→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧きた。
examples.english: Recent flat-screen TVs have good picture quality, and prices have come down.

notes:
Compound of {薄型|うすがた} (thin-bodied) + ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧ (TV). Refers to modern flat-panel sets, contrasted with the older ブラウン⟦{管|かん}→管：09749_kan⟧ cathode-ray-tube televisions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薄型|うすがた}テレビ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to mount a flat-screen TV on the wall
- ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{薄型|うすがた}テレビ: large flat-screen TV

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{液晶|えきしょう}→液晶：16387_ekishou⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧: LCD television — names the panel type
- ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧: large-screen TV — emphasizes size rather than thinness
